method: Questions were reviewed in independent blind passes. Solvers did not see the answer, explanation, or verification expression; responses were compared with the answer key, with exact Python calculations used where applicable.
caveats: The blind solver and original author came from the same model family, so shared misconceptions may remain. Geometry questions were reviewed from text alone, without diagrams.

passes.name: A: Full blind review (single round)
passes.adjudication: All three disagreements were solver errors; the answer key was correct.

passes.name: B: Targeted blind review of higher-risk questions
passes.scope: All questions not auto-verified for numeric, choice, or short-answer types, plus every advanced question.

passes.name: C: Independent review of primary-school questions
passes.adjudication: This pass reviewed primary-school prompts and choices without showing answers, verification expressions, or explanations. No disagreements were recorded.

passes.name: D: High-school compulsory questions checked against generated verifiers
passes.note: The builder generated answers by evaluating the same verification expressions used by verify_questions.py, which then compared the results with the stored answers. This checks expression and formatting consistency; it is not an independent blind-solving pass.

passes.name: E: High-school selective-compulsory questions checked against generated verifiers
passes.note: The builder generated answers by evaluating the same verification expressions used by verify_questions.py, which then compared the results with the stored answers. This checks expression and formatting consistency; it is not an independent blind-solving pass.

adjudicated_solver_errors.裁决: Subtracting the second equation from the first gives 3y=9, so y=3. Substituting into 3x−y=3 gives x=2. The bank answer (2, 3) is correct; the independent solver miscalculated x.
The median is the mean of the two middle values, 7 and a: (7+a)/2=8. Thus a=9, and 7≤9≤10 confirms the data are ordered. The bank answer is correct.
There are six equally likely arrangements. The two even numbers are 132 and 312, so the probability is 2/6=1/3. The bank answer is correct.

corrections.reason: The original wording incorrectly referred to a chart. The revision clarifies the four collinear points; the answer remains 6.

corrections.reason: The term can use divisor n or n−1. The revision states the intended divisor n used at this grade level; answer 0.4 remains unchanged.

Examples: cnm_228_q4 states the objective as “to provide more benefit to the customer”; cnm_293_q4 specifies 11–20 inclusive; and cnm_290_q1 instructs the learner to retain a decimal and use √3≈1.73.
